messages.content:
src/forecast.ts has turned into one big module: the forecasting model and the general
matrix code it needs (identity, transpose, multiply, multiplyVector, and solve, the
Gaussian elimination solver for the normal equations) live in the same file, and
src/backtest.ts imports multiplyVector from it. The workforce analytics team wants to use
the matrix code in their capacity dashboard, and we agreed the interface with them in
docs/MATRIX_API.md.

Please move the matrix helpers into a new module, src/matrix.ts, that follows
docs/MATRIX_API.md:

- identity, transpose, multiply, and multiplyVector should work exactly as they do now,
  with the same error messages;
- solve should give the same solutions as now, but leave the matrix and the vector it is
  given unchanged, and handle a singular matrix the way the document describes;
- src/forecast.ts and src/backtest.ts should import the helpers from src/matrix.ts, and
  src/forecast.ts should stop exporting them, so that there is one place to import them
  from. Its forecasting functions (fitModel, predict, forecast, residualStats, and
  designRow) stay where they are.

This is a refactor, so ticketcast fit, ticketcast forecast, and ticketcast backtest should
print exactly what they print now, and a history file that cannot be read or fitted
should still stop with the same message and exit status 2.
